title: Facebook Ad Library Scraper - Competitor Ads & Creatives
description: Scrape ads from the public Facebook Ad Library. For a low-cost test, use one keyword or Page ID, one country, active ads, maxResults 5-10, and residential proxy.

keywords.title: Search Keywords
keywords.description: Search keywords to find ads in the Facebook Ad Library. Start with one keyword for a low-cost test. Multiple keywords will be searched in sequence.

pageIds.title: Page IDs
pageIds.description: Facebook Page IDs to scrape ads for directly. Enter numeric Page IDs. Start with one Page ID for a controlled test.

advertiserNames.title: Advertiser / Page Names
advertiserNames.description: Advertiser or Facebook Page names to search for in the Ad Library. Start with one advertiser name for a controlled test.

country.title: Country
country.description: Filter ads by country. Use one ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. US, GB, DE) for tests. ALL can expand results and usage.

adStatus.title: Ad Status
adStatus.description: Filter by ad active/inactive status. Active is recommended for low-cost competitor checks.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Filter by platform where the ad is displayed.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ads to scrape per search query. Use 5-10 for test runs; increase only after output looks correct.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for the crawler. Residential proxies are recommended and billed as platform usage.
